steps.title: Critic: second-model review found 2 problems in 8 items
details: The Critic objected to the candid management verdict: the quoted sentences don't fully support it, so it looks overstated. Reason given: The impairment is attributed to external client financial distress and bankruptcy, not the company's own decisions or execution, failing the definition of the claimed verdict.
The Critic objected to the rational capital allocation rationale: it says "provides the specific dividend amount per share", which the quoted sentences don't show.

steps.title: Critic sent 2 findings back for repair
details: Candid management: constrained retry (the agent must cite something new or lower its verdict).
Rational capital allocation: rationale rewrite (the verdict stands, the rationale is rewritten from the quotes).

steps.title: Model call 1 for candid management: 2,572 tokens in, 105 out, ~$0.0008 at paid rates
details: The model decided to submit its finding: insufficient evidence, citing nothing.

Its rationale: The provided 10-K text attributes financial setbacks, such as impairments and credit losses, primarily to external factors like client bankruptcy and financial distress, rather than the company's own decisions or execution. As a 10-K is a limited guide to candour, and no evidence of management acknowledging its own mistakes or missed targets was found, the verdict is insufficient evidence.
